        'kWh': 'energy',
        'lx': 'illuminance',
        'hPa': 'pressure',
        'kPa': 'pressure',
        'mbar': 'pressure',
        'dBm': 'signal_strength'
    },
    // sensor device class from property and unit
    'property': {
        'humidity': ['%', 'humidity'],
        'battery': ['%', 'battery'],
        'soil_moisture': ['%', 'moisture'],
        'co2': ['ppm', 'carbon_dioxide'],
        'pm25': ['µg/m³', 'pm25'],
        'pm10': ['µg/m³', 'pm10']

    'diagnostic': ['linkquality', 'battery', 'battery_low', 'last_seen', 'availability', 'device_temperature', 'power_outage_count'],
    // transient enums published as text (remote buttons)
    'text': ['action'],
    // Zigbee2MQTT bridge as a device: entity: [name, type, access, ha type, ha device class, ha category]
    'bridge': {
        'state': ['Etat du pont', 'binary', 1, 'binary_sensor', 'connectivity', 'diagnostic'],
        'permit_join': ['Appairage', 'binary', 3, 'switch', '', ''],
        'version': ['Version', 'text', 1, 'sensor', '', 'diagnostic']
    },
    // entities not described by exposes, added when Zigbee2MQTT publishes them
    'extra': {
        'last_seen': {
            'property': 'last_seen', 'name': 'Dernier signal', 'type': 'text', 'access': 1, 'group': 'sensor', 'unit': '',

            'ha_type': 'binary_sensor', 'ha_device': 'connectivity', 'ha_state': '', 'ha_category': 'diagnostic'
        }
    },
    // permit join duration in seconds (maximum)
    'permit': 254
};

return msg;

info:
Zigbee2MQTT MQTT topics and messages: https://www.zigbee2mqtt.io/guide/usage/mqtt_topics_and_messages.html
Zigbee2MQTT exposes: https://www.zigbee2mqtt.io/guide/usage/exposes.html

Les entités DKNR sont construites à partir des exposes de chaque appareil (bridge/devices).
L'identifiant d'un appareil est son adresse IEEE sans 0x : il ne change pas si l'appareil est renommé.
